{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "High-waist jogger pants, tapered cut, ankle length, soft heather grey, brushed cotton jersey with a slight stretch.
Relaxed-fit crew neck sweatshirt, boxy silhouette, mid-thigh hem, creamy off-white, heavyweight organic fleece.
Minimalist flat lace-up sneakers, rounded toe, standard length, classic white, durable canvas upper with rubber cupsole.

This outfit seamlessly bridges your morning yoga session and afternoon coffee catch-up by prioritizing comfort without sacrificing style. The soft jersey of the pants and the cozy fleece top ensure you feel at ease during movement, while the neutral color palette transitions effortlessly from the studio mat to a café table. Each piece is selected specifically for breathability and ease of motion, respecting your active lifestyle and refusal of restrictive clothing."}
